strategy.primary: Forced combat into Clues: each Rani ETB or attack puts Mark of the Rani (+2/+2 and goaded) on a creature, goaded creatures hitting opponents investigate, and the goad Aura suite makes more goaded attackers. Academy Manufactor and Erdwal Illuminator multiply the Clues.
strategy.secondary: Blink The Rani for more Marks (Thassa, Displacer Kitten), turn artifact tokens into mana, damage and extra turns (Urza, Bjorna, Time Sieve), and use mass goad (Disrupt Decorum, Kardur, Spectacular Showdown).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: The Rani
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever The Rani enters or attacks, create a red Aura enchantment token named Mark of the Rani attached to another target creature. That token has enchant creature and "Enchanted creature gets +2/+2 and is goaded."
Whenever a goaded creature deals combat damage to one of your opponents, investigate.
